svg.title: Resumes at one time on one node: the time of each request, and the rate
svg.desc: Two panels for bursts of 1, 10, 50, 100 and 150 resumes at one time on one node with 24 vCPU, three bursts for each size and 933 requests in all, every one answered with 200. The slowest of 10 took 0.43 s. At 50 at one time the median was 1.2 to 1.3 s, and at 150 the slowest took 4.1 s. From 50 upward the node finished 36 to 39 resumes each second.
svg.text: one burst, its requests from first to last answer
